text: As of 2025, 92% of the Top 100 suppliers in direct purchasing have signed the Supplier Code of Conduct, thus guaranteeing mutual commitment to fair practices, human rights, health and safety, and environmental protection. [#6941](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6941)

Implementing an integrated sustainable purchasing approach Risk and supplier assessments S2-2 Due to their specific features and the materiality of the topic for the Group, suppliers of direct purchases are subject to specific assessments. [#4113](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4113)

Risks resulting from the activities of subcontractors or suppliers Since October 2019, the Sustainable and Ethical Purchasing Charter, (now the "Supplier Code of Conduct"), has been in effect within the Group. [#6888](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6888)
Assessing direct suppliers is one of the objectives of the Group's buyers and of the purchasing directors. [#4152](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4152)
The Purchasing Department therefore actively monitors changes in energy costs and contracts with preferred suppliers. [#3153](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-3153)

To date, for direct purchases and the Group's Top 100 suppliers (covering more than 78% of the Group's direct purchases), 92% of third parties have signed the Supplier Code of Conduct. [#4080](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4080)

The Group places a particular emphasis on managing third party risks and in 2016, as part of its vigilance plan implementation, it adopted a Sustainable and Ethical Purchasing Charter (or "Supplier Code of Conduct"), as well as supplier risk assessment and CSR audit procedures (see section 3.4.6 "Working responsibly with workers in the value chain"). [#7012](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-7012)

It defines and monitors the purchasing strategies for each category, is responsible for supplier selection, manages a list of the Group's approved suppliers, and coordinates cross-functional actions with the country buyers. [#1980](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1980)

Key performance indicator IRO Implementing an integrated sustainable purchasing approach Share of procurement spend with direct suppliers that have undergone a CSR assessment in the last three years(a) Number of on-site CSR audits conducted during the year(b) Share of Group and country buyers that have received training on CSR topics IRO13 Share of Group buyers whose duties include the signing of the Supplier Code of Conduct for master agreements Share of the Top 100 direct suppliers that have signed the Supplier Code of Conduct IRO13 Target addressing the material impacts, risks and opportunities (IROs) identified for the Group regarding ESRS S2 - Workers in the value chain. [#4056](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4056)

Operational governance With respect to governance, the Group's Purchasing Director reports to the Engineering, Purchasing and Supply Chain Director, who is a member of the Executive Committee. [#4063](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4063)

At the end of 2025, the Group exceeded its goal of assessing 95% of purchases made from direct suppliers, with a record performance of 96.1%. [#4060](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4060)

They operate in a number of countries; "PLO: Preferred Local" category is the list of suppliers under the control (master agreement and management) of the Purchasing Department. [#1969](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1969)

The Group signs framework agreements with key suppliers for purchases of industrial equipment, production inputs such as cleaning products and general purchases. [#1998](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1998)

The Group's purchasing is divided into three segments: direct purchases (textiles and hygiene and well-being), indirect purchases and industrial purchases. [#4022](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4022)

To avoid a potentially material adverse effect on its business, Elis continuously and proactively adjusts its purchasing strategies, mainly by: implementing a multiple sourcing strategy (long- and short-distance imports; multiple suppliers) to diversify its sources and optimize cost/ lead time profiles based on needs and constraints; introducing quality/CSR monitoring and audits to verify that its suppliers comply with the Elis Group's purchasing and CSR policies; negotiating balanced agreements with its suppliers, so that supplier strategies can be put in place over time. [#1981](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1981)
Elis's relationship with its suppliers is governed by its code of ethics and responsible purchasing charter. [#73](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-73)

Listing subject to triple validation using a written procedure (applicant, segment purchasing manager and purchasing directors) and to the systematic and binding signature of the Supplier Code of Conduct by all new suppliers. [#6917](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6917)

Working responsibly with workers in the value chain ESRS S2 Context The Purchasing Departments play an important role in choosing suppliers of products and services around the world. [#4020](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4020)
The central purchasing department is organized into key categories. [#1979](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1979)

The Group holds competitive tenders on a regular basis with its panel of suppliers, as well as other suppliers on the market, to make sure its purchasing is competitive (once or twice a year for textiles). [#1985](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1985)
This measure covers over 96.1% of procurement spend with direct suppliers at end- (1) Article L. [#6892](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6892)
The supplier base consists of two types of suppliers: "PCO: Preferred Corporate" category is the list of go-to suppliers. [#1967](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1967)

Since 2006, the Group's commitment has been detailed in a Supplier Code of Conduct, which describes Elis's relationships with suppliers beyond the simple purchase of goods and services. [#4040](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4040)

The supplier base is extensive and comprises "corporate" third parties, which are managed centrally, and suppliers that are managed locally, i.e. at the country or site level. [#4025](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4025)

Supplier logistics specifications are appended to the master agreement and indicate an inventory (of finished goods or fabric) that the supplier must have set aside for Elis at all times. [#1996](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1996)

More specifically, the Purchasing policy (relating to upstream value chain topics, covering a material IRO) is intended to apply within no more than two years of an entity's acquisition. [#4196](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4196)

The Supplier Code of Conduct applies to all Group suppliers (direct, indirect or industrial), whether new or existing partners. [#4312](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4312)
Elis controls its supply chain: 96% of direct purchases have been subject to a CSR assessment of the supplier. [#72](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-72)

In this regard, the Group set a goal of achieving at least 95% of procurement spend with direct suppliers that have undergone a CSR assessment in the last three years. [#4179](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4179)

The purchasing structure and responsibility for it are managed at the Group level with the support of local buyers based in different countries. [#4064](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4064)
